name: L10 PanoLab new-city temporal lexical-then-appearance confirmation
question: Does the unchanged exact-token-first router transfer to the two new Caen targets without conflicting with the already sealed 2/2 appearance result?
observed_before_freeze: Human review had already exposed readable Euromaster and Bibliotheque Maladrerie signage, and the sealed temporal appearance branch was 2/2 correct. No OCR output, OCR confidence, normalized token, token-bank match, or lexical routing decision had been observed on any selected confirmation image.

routing_contract.lexical: Run the exact frozen PP-OCRv6 medium entrance-window pipeline and long-short exact-token bank across prev/anchor/next for every one of the eight roster names.
routing_contract.unique_own_match: If and only if the requested target is the sole matched roster name, emit TEMPORAL_EXACT_TOKEN_SEARCH_PRIORITY_CANDIDATE.
routing_contract.no_match: Reuse the already sealed temporal appearance candidate or UNKNOWN without recomputation or threshold changes.
routing_contract.unique_wrong_or_multiple_matches: Return UNKNOWN_LEXICAL_CONFLICT_KEEP_SEARCHING; never let appearance override a lexical conflict.
routing_contract.authority: All emitted candidates remain SEARCH_PRIORITY_ONLY with no portal-ownership binding.
routing_contract.no_adaptation: No OCR model, confidence rule, text normalization, target spelling, long-short split, token rule, crop, image, roster, fallback, or gate may change after output.

required: both confirmation sequences and all six frames evaluated
at least one new-city target produces a unique own exact-token match
2/2 combined candidates correct with 0 wrong and 0 UNKNOWN
0 wrong-target exact-token matches across 14 counterfactual trials
gate.failure_policy: Preserve the first result. Do not tune target aliases, token rules, OCR settings, or samples.

research_basis.title: GoMatching++: Parameter- and Data-Efficient Arbitrary-Shaped Video Text Spotting and Benchmarking
research_basis.use: Motivates accumulating text evidence across short and long temporal context. This router retains deterministic exact tokens and does not implement GoMatching++.

research_basis.title: GloTSFormer: Global Video Text Spotting Transformer
research_basis.use: Motivates preserving historical text evidence rather than making an adjacent-frame-only decision. This replay does not implement its Transformer.

claim_boundary.allowed: OCR-unseen Development evidence about whether the already fixed exact-token temporal branch complements or safely defers to the sealed appearance branch on exactly two new-city, target-way/item-disjoint Caen targets in one same-provider eight-target closed roster.
not_allowed: blind, independent, provider-disjoint, fully pixel-unseen, open-world, conformal, FDR-controlled, or deployment confirmation
a same-name OCR token proving exact entity identity, sign-to-building association, facade ownership, or portal ownership
access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, deployment performance, or safety
